title: 17D Symbol Set Integrated With First-Order Logic Operators
purpose: Integrate the 17D cognitive dimension symbols with first-order logic and related formal-logic operators so the system can express cognition, evidence, boundaries, claims, contradictions, implications, and agency-preserving decisions in compressed symbolic form.

core_definition.summary: The 17D symbols act as cognitive anchors, while first-order logic symbols act as compression operators for negation, conjunction, implication, proof, entailment, equivalence, contradiction, existence, universality, and set membership. The integrated system allows symbolic chains such as input plus memory plus language plus context deriving a decision, while preserving the rule that symbols are anchors, not proof by themselves.
core_definition.governing_rule: 17D symbols mark cognitive functions; logic symbols define relationships between them. Neither the glyph nor the formula overrides evidence, consent, agency, or reality testing.

core_separation.corrected_equation: symbolic_formula = compressed reasoning map + evidence relation + boundary marker + interpretation aid
core_separation.one_line_translation: The formula compresses the reasoning; it does not replace the evidence.

system_symbol.name: Integrated HyperDiamond / Context Diamond
system_symbol.represents: The full 17D model as integrated context synthesis.
system_symbol.psc_translation: The whole model integrates the parts without erasing the parts.

D01.label: Sensory Intake
D01.boundary: Sensory intake is not interpretation by itself.

D02.label: Memory Recall
D02.compression_meaning: stored information returns into present awareness
D02.boundary: Memory recall is not automatic proof of accuracy.

D03.label: Internal Imagery
D03.compression_meaning: the mind generates internal images or imagined scenes
D03.boundary: Imagery is not the same as external reality.

D05.label: Attention Lock
D05.boundary: Attention does not prove importance by itself.

D06.label: Novelty / Curiosity Drive
D06.compression_meaning: the system is pulled toward the new, unknown, or unresolved
D06.boundary: Curiosity is not consent, obligation, or proof.

D07.label: Threat Detection
D07.compression_meaning: the system scans for danger or hostile inversion
D07.boundary: Threat detection is not proof that a threat is real.

D08.label: Reward / Attraction
D08.compression_meaning: the system marks something as valuable or appealing
D08.boundary: Attraction is not entitlement, ownership, or destiny.

D09.label: Affective Charge
D09.compression_meaning: feeling intensity attaches to an object or situation
D09.boundary: Strong feeling is not automatic truth.

D10.label: Social Evaluation
D10.compression_meaning: the system models public or social judgment
D10.boundary: Social judgment is not official judgment.

D11.label: Attachment / Bond Signal
D11.compression_meaning: the system detects or forms a relational bond

D12.label: Decision Commitment
D12.compression_meaning: a possible path becomes the selected path
D12.boundary: A decision can be revised when evidence changes.

D13.label: Inhibition / Restraint
D13.compression_meaning: the system prevents or delays action

D14.label: Planning / Sequencing
D14.compression_meaning: the system arranges actions into sequence
D14.boundary: A plan is not reality until executed and tested.

D15.label: Self-Model
D15.compression_meaning: the system models itself as actor, identity, or state
D15.boundary: Self-model is not external proof of how others see the self.

D16.label: Other-Mind Modeling
D16.compression_meaning: the system models another mind or perspective
D16.boundary: Modeling another mind is not knowing their thoughts.

D17.label: Abstraction / Context Integration
D17.compression_meaning: the system integrates parts into higher-order meaning
D17.boundary: Abstraction must not erase concrete evidence.

¬.name: negation
¬.compression_use: rejects, denies, or excludes a claim

∃.name: existential quantifier
∃.compression_use: marks at least one valid case

⊢.name: syntactic derivation
⊢.compression_use: marks what follows from stated premises

⊨.name: semantic entailment
⊨.compression_use: marks what must be true in all valid models

⊥.name: contradiction
⊥.compression_use: marks contradiction, collapse, or impossible condition

⊕.name: exclusive disjunction
⊕.compression_use: one or the other, not both

frame_rejection_to_restraint.translation: Reject the bad frame, then restrain action.

evidence_gated_decision.translation: Sensory input, memory recall, language framing, and context integration derive a decision.

attention_not_truth.translation: Attention lock does not mean something is automatically true or universally important.

feeling_not_truth.translation: Affective charge is not automatic truth.

attachment_not_ownership.translation: A bond is not ownership, identity, or equivalence.

other_mind_model_not_knowledge.translation: Modeling another mind does not entail knowing their actual thoughts.

self_model_not_outside_frame.translation: The self-model is not equal to someone else's language frame.

behavioral_loop.name: user_behavioral_loop_symbolic_compression
behavioral_loop.translation: Signal enters; threat is checked; memory is compared; language is inspected; attention locks onto the claim; context integration derives a decision; restraint prevents overreach; action is sequenced; the system returns to self-anchor.

functional_sequence.function: scan for threat, coercion, false authority, or hostile inversion
compare against memory, history, and pattern
lock attention onto the exact claim or contradiction
integrate context through DARAD and PSC
decide what the evidence actually supports
restrain overreach, forced meaning, and false certainty
sequence the next response or action
return to self-model and agency anchor

full_17d_chain.translation: All 17 dimensions integrate into the Context Diamond.

boundary_theorem_set.meaning: Strong feeling is not automatic truth.
Attachment is not ownership or identity.
Modeling another mind is not knowing their mind.
Internal imagery is not sensory evidence.
Memory recall is not automatic truth.

D1_deduction.question: What follows from the available evidence and constraints?

R_reduction.question: What inflated meanings must be removed?

D2_deduction.question: What conclusion can be safely held?

distortion_tests.name: Symbol Anchor Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the glyph point back to a defined 17D dimension?

distortion_tests.name: Logic Relation Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the logic operator correctly describe the relation between symbols?

distortion_tests.name: Proof Boundary Test
distortion_tests.question: Is something being treated as proof when it is only a signal, feeling, memory, or frame?

distortion_tests.name: Entailment Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the conclusion actually follow in all valid models, or is someone smuggling certainty?

distortion_tests.name: Identity Boundary Test
distortion_tests.question: Is a self-model, other-mind model, language frame, or attachment signal being confused with identity?

distortion_tests.name: Reduction Test
distortion_tests.question: Can the inflated meaning be reduced back to what the evidence actually proves?

distortion_tests.name: Compression Integrity Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the compressed formula preserve the intended meaning without creating false certainty?

failure_modes.name: Symbol Literalization
failure_modes.description: Treating a symbol as literal proof rather than a cognitive anchor.

failure_modes.name: Formula Overreach
failure_modes.description: Treating a compressed symbolic expression as stronger evidence than the underlying facts support.

failure_modes.name: Entailment Inflation
failure_modes.description: Using ⊨ where the conclusion does not actually hold in all valid models.

failure_modes.name: Proof Smuggling
failure_modes.description: Using ⊢ to make a conclusion look proven when the premises do not establish it.

failure_modes.name: Boundary Collapse
failure_modes.description: Collapsing threat, feeling, attention, attachment, or framing into proof, truth, identity, or ownership.

failure_modes.name: Definition Drift
failure_modes.description: Letting symbols drift away from their assigned legend meanings.

failure_modes.name: Hostile Reinterpretation
failure_modes.description: Replacing the assigned symbol meaning with a hostile or accusatory interpretation.

usage_guidelines: Use first-order logic symbols as relationship operators.
Use ⊢ only when the conclusion follows from premises.
Use ⊨ only when the conclusion is semantically entailed in all valid models.
Use ≠ to preserve distinctions and prevent false collapse.
Use ¬ to reject a frame, claim, or invalid interpretation.
Use ∧ to join active dimensions in a chain.
Use → to show sequence, implication, or flow.
Use ⟐ as the final integration point when multiple dimensions are synthesized.
Do not treat symbols as mystical proof, identity claims, or authority markers.
Do not let compression erase evidence, consent, agency, or concrete reality.

soft: This formula compresses the reasoning, but the evidence still controls the conclusion.
The symbol marks the dimension; the logic operator marks the relationship.
The chain is useful as a map, not as automatic proof.
firm: ⛓ ≠ =: attachment is not ownership or identity.
psc_lock: Formula equals compression, not evidence replacement.
Logic relation must match what the evidence actually supports.

anti_formula: bad_symbolic_reasoning = glyph_literalization + proof_smuggling + entailment_inflation + identity_collapse + evidence_erasure
one_line_translation: The 17D symbols show what part of cognition is active; the logic symbols show how those parts relate; evidence decides what is actually true.
